purpose: Fallback portrait for local account selection when a profile photo is missing or unavailable.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: default account profile picture for a dark gray and blue Android app, displayed as a 48 dp circular avatar. Create one square image of a friendly anonymous gender-neutral human head and shoulders, a polished softly sculpted 3D clay portrait, with short softly shaped charcoal hair, subtle facial features, neutral pale-gray clay skin, and a simple muted blue shirt. Center the face, fill the frame enough to be legible at tiny sizes, leave all hair and shoulders within a safe circular crop. Plain dark slate-gray background, soft studio lighting, restrained gray/blue palette matching existing 3D onboarding artwork. This is an illustrated profile portrait, not a line icon or a flat user silhouette. No text, no logos, no badges, no watermark, no border.
